plain: A fast way to check whether two pieces of text share most of the same words, used to spot copied text.
eli5: Checking whether two bags of marbles hold mostly the same colours without counting every marble.
technical: A hashing scheme (Broder 1997) that estimates the Jaccard similarity of two sets; HarmBench grades its 100 copyright behaviours this way instead of with its classifier, flagging a completion if any window's MinHash similarity to the reference exceeds 0.6.
